name: League of Legends 2027 Regional Player Eligibility
appliesTo: Official League of Legends Tier 1 and official Tier 2 regional competitions in the 2027 season, for all teams (Kairos and non-Kairos). Counter-Strike is not affected.

regions.label: LCS
regions.eligibleTerritories: United States, Canada, Mexico, Central America, Caribbean

regions.label: LEC
regions.eligibleTerritories: Eligible European, Middle Eastern, and African competitive territories

regions.label: LCP
regions.eligibleTerritories: Asia-Pacific, including Taiwan, Vietnam, Japan, Southeast Asia, and Oceania, excluding mainland China and South Korea

regions.label: CBLOL
regions.eligibleTerritories: Brazil and the rest of South America

rules: No player may compete as an import outside an eligible region.
A player with valid dual citizenship may select one eligible competitive region for the season.
Competitive region selection is locked for the season.
Residency alone does not grant eligibility.
Coaches, analysts, and support staff are exempt from player eligibility restrictions.
Existing player contracts are not automatically voided.
Ineligible players cannot be registered for official matches in the affected region.
The rule applies to official regional Tier 1 and Tier 2 leagues.
notes: Announced by Riot Games on 2027-01-26 (Episode 111) and applies to the Kairos Universe 2027 continuity layer only.
The region import aliases (NA, EU, KR, CH, PCS, SA) are spreadsheet/import aliases, not official league names.

This ruleset does not rewrite any external player nationality, region, team, or contract, and the frozen pre-Worlds 2026 reference dataset is unchanged. Player-specific roster, retirement, and contract events are separate entities handled in a later canon update.
